title: Standard end-of-rent transition to Maintenance status
gherkin:
Feature: End-of-rent lifecycle transition
  Scenario: Rent reaches scheduled end date and transitions to Maintenance
    Given an authenticated user has an active rent for an available rentable item
    And the rent has a scheduled end date
    When the scheduled end date is reached
    Then the system shall update the rent status to 'Maintenance'
    And the item shall appear non-rentable during the Maintenance period
rationale: Validates the core requirement that upon reaching the rental end date, the system transitions the rent status to 'Maintenance'. This is the primary behavior specified in the operative context.
usedContextItems: Upon reaching the rental end date, the system shall update the rent status to 'Maintenance'|Maintenance period blocks rental activity and makes the item appear non-rentable
